evidence.reference_title: PRKDC / severe combined immunodeficiency due to DNA-PKcs deficiency (Definitive)
evidence.snippet: Nonsense or frameshift variants have not yet been described in humans.

nodes.description: The C.B-17 scid mouse carries a spontaneous Prkdc mutation that removes DNA-PK activity. It lacks T and B cells, its cells are hypersensitive to ionizing radiation, and its V(D)J recombination block is leaky. It is also the basis of the AIRE studies in thymic epithelium. It does not show the neurodevelopmental defect seen in the most severe human case.
Reported in the infants with the classical SCID presentation.

evidence.snippet: Unexpectedly, the patient was also dysmorphic; showed severe growth failure, microcephaly, and seizures; and had profound, globally impaired neurological function.

nodes.description: Classical radiosensitive T-B-NK+ SCID in infancy, reported with the first founder-allele patient and with the compound heterozygous patient. Most later-reported patients have a leaky, later-onset form instead.

evidence.reference_title: A DNA-PKcs mutation in a radiosensitive T-B- SCID patient inhibits Artemis activation and nonhomologous end-joining.
evidence.snippet: Here we have identified the first human RS-SCID patient to our knowledge with a DNA-PKcs missense mutation (L3062R).

evidence.reference_title: PRKDC mutations in a SCID patient with profound neurological abnormalities.
evidence.snippet: The patient suffered SCID with reduced or absent T and B cells, as predicted from PRKDC-deficient animal models.

evidence.reference_title: PRKDC mutations associated with immunodeficiency, granuloma, and autoimmune regulator-dependent autoimmunity.
evidence.snippet: Splenic biopsy specimens revealed well-circumscribed caseating epithelioid granulomas with negative special stains for microorganisms

nodes.description: Recurrent homozygous missense founder allele in patients of Turkish ancestry. It preserves DNA-PKcs kinase activity and DNA end binding but impairs Artemis activation and overall end joining. It has been found both in classical radiosensitive SCID and in later-onset combined immunodeficiency with granulomas and autoimmunity.

evidence.reference_title: PRKDC mutations associated with immunodeficiency, granuloma, and autoimmune regulator-dependent autoimmunity.
evidence.snippet: Sanger sequencing identified a c.9185T>G (p.Leu3062Arg) homozygous missense variant and a homozygous c.6340delGAG (pGly2113del) deletion in PRKDC in this patient

evidence.reference_title: PRKDC mutations associated with immunodeficiency, granuloma, and autoimmune regulator-dependent autoimmunity.
evidence.snippet: All 3 patients shared a common Turkish ancestry, suggesting a founder effect for these variants.
